name: sdlc
description: Spec-driven delivery for agents: /sdlc:init generates the instruction hierarchy and descriptors for your repo; spec → mockup → implement → qa → ship → review runs unattended; issues enter through triage, PRs leave through a gated human merge

interface.longDescription: A task router, an approval gate that is a spec, dense test floors, automated QA, and a fire-and-forget queue that turns approved specs into reviewable pull requests. Compose with Slop Guard for hook enforcement, Superpowers for disciplines, and Ponytail for implementation minimalism.
defaultPrompt: $init — set up this repo for the SDLC pipeline
$spec <TICKET> — turn a ticket into an executable spec
